project.title: Native normalized company bootstrap and early upgrades
project.goal: Create the full company schema in native Rust and migrate known normalized early prefixes on private copies.
project.scope: R12 existing empty/normalized prefixes0–31; prior suffix32–36 contract preserved, full legacy normalization and writer gates unchanged.

component.storage.description: Own bounded private SQLite migration rehearsal.

boundary.responsibility: Capture, recover, validate, migrate and discard private copies.
boundary.rationale: Original writer admission is not yet complete.
excludes: Live migrations, domain writes and promotion

action.normalize_company_vat.description: FK-safe canonical VAT legacy-kind normalization on complete company prefixes

preconditions: Authorized local read; complete exact known schema and strict provenance; no original write/adoption authority.
postconditions: Original source unchanged and private copy discarded.
Only specified legacy-kind/data effects; complete schema, FKs, non-kind cells, history and guards preserved.
Full-prefix and bounded-suffix evidence explicitly scoped; no writer authority.
external_effects: Read/stat source files; recover/migrate/delete private disposable files only.

idempotency.rationale: Same normalized copy has zero further kind changes and preserves exact existing data.

boundaries.rationale: Exact complete physical schema and empty history; VAT semantic conflicts refuse.

concurrency.rationale: Capture stable source while legacy reader/writer may be active.

atomicity.rationale: One immediate data transaction encloses VAT validation, guard changes and later data effects; actual SQL refusal and process death prove rollback.

action.normalize_company_vat.behavior: Strict full schema/history admission; immediate data transaction validates VAT, preserves children/typed cells, drops only named update guard, bulk relabels/restores, checks integrity; existing data normalization/versioned steps and checked copy cleanup.

scenario.normal.description: Exact complete DDL/typed cell parity and allowed kind count; old provenance exact.

scenario.given: Complete direct company prefix1–36 with strict history and canonical legacy VAT cells.
scenario.when: Run corrected full migration on private native copy and real TS oracle.
scenario.then: Exact complete DDL/typed cell parity and allowed kind count; old provenance exact.

scenario.history.description: Refuse before gaining VAT normalization access; retain bounded suffix scope for supported minimal fixtures without legacy VAT.

scenario.given: Gapped/tampered/newer history, unknown source object or non-full layout with legacy VAT.
scenario.then: Refuse before gaining VAT normalization access; retain bounded suffix scope for supported minimal fixtures without legacy VAT.

scenario.checkpoint.description: Typed refusal with whole data/guard rollback and no source effects.

scenario.given: Registered mismatch, deregistered mixed cadence, duplicate/reported overlap or year below100.
scenario.when: Validate inside owned immediate data transaction using company ID1/default semantics.
scenario.then: Typed refusal with whole data/guard rollback and no source effects.

scenario.isolation.description: Original inventory unchanged and cleanup checked.

scenario.given: Current full source with active WAL or unsafe/missing path.
scenario.then: Original inventory unchanged and cleanup checked.

scenario.failure.description: Every VAT/role/retention cell and exact named guard restored to old state.

scenario.given: Other period trigger aborts UPDATE, or referenced bank guard rejects a later data effect after VAT changes.
scenario.then: Every VAT/role/retention cell and exact named guard restored to old state.

scenario.crash.description: Complete old current schema/FK data/history and exact guard; retry succeeds.

scenario.given: Actual current36 child paused after named guard drop, kind update or exact restore.
scenario.then: Complete old current schema/FK data/history and exact guard; retry succeeds.

scenario.usage.description: Structured help and exit2 for invalid input; no original effects.

scenario.given: Existing invalid CLI flags or help discovery.
scenario.when: Use unchanged command name/parser and updated scope text.
scenario.then: Structured help and exit2 for invalid input; no original effects.

scenario.guards.description: Foreign keys and all original child/non-kind cells intact; restored guards refuse mutation.

scenario.given: Canonical VAT parent has full-width ID and migration22 decisions/open-item children.
scenario.when: Relabel only kind then attempt later protected changes.
scenario.then: Foreign keys and all original child/non-kind cells intact; restored guards refuse mutation.

scenario.repeat.description: Zero VAT relabels; exact schema/cells/history/timestamps unchanged.

scenario.then: Zero VAT relabels; exact schema/cells/history/timestamps unchanged.

scenario.concurrent.description: No validation/update race or externally visible unguarded interval; no parentDROP or FK deferral.

scenario.given: Canonical source eligible for legacy VAT relabel.
scenario.when: Validate, capture/drop named update guard, bulk UPDATE, restore and verify inside one immediate transaction.
scenario.then: No validation/update race or externally visible unguarded interval; no parentDROP or FK deferral.
